from build123d import *

# Main body
body_length = 58.7
body_diameter = 38.4
# Shoulder
shoulder_length = 21.3
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
# Inner bore
inner_diameter = 18.7

body = Pos(body_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(body_diameter/2, body_length)
shoulder = Pos(body_length + shoulder_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(shoulder_diameter/2, shoulder_length)
outer = body + shoulder
inner = Pos((body_length + shoulder_length)/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_diameter/2, body_length + shoulder_length)
part = outer - inner
part.name = "stepped_hollow_cylinder"
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

outer_radius = 39.99765882917684
hub_radius = 12.867484175607568
height = 34.1986251776094

part.name = "impeller"
